fusions.name: Quarry Call
fusions.desc: Calls the flock onto a quarry with a strike that deals 26 damage, up to 1.4 times that at its full 6 tiles, and leaves it [Marked] for 10 seconds. If it hits, every ally strikes 20% harder for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Closing Rake
fusions.desc: You close up to 6 tiles on the target and rake it for 13 damage, leaving it [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 3 seconds and slowing it by 30% for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Forward Scout
fusions.desc: Sends a chick out to scout for 20 seconds, pecking an enemy within 5 tiles for 5 damage every 1.2 seconds.

fusions.name: Final Stretch
fusions.desc: Your damage rises by 12% against enemies below 50% health.
